summary: Loads VIOSO 6 calibration data from .vwf files for calibrated projector output workflows.

key_params.name: projectorindex
key_params.note: Output projector index in the calibration file

common_gotchas: Calibration results saved from OEM versions of VIOSO cannot be used, including .vwf and MPCDI files.
Use MPCDI TOP for MPCDI files exported from VIOSO when that format is appropriate.
Projector Index must match the desired projector entry in the calibration data.
Export a Wings/VIOSO .vwf calibration from VIOSO 6 for this TOP rather than pointing it at arbitrary calibration data.
key_concepts: Vioso TOP loads VIOSO 6 .vwf calibration files for projector warping and blending.
The configfile parameter points to the calibration export while projectorindex selects which projector entry to output.
MPCDI exports from VIOSO belong in MPCDI TOP rather than Vioso TOP.
The operator is a TouchDesigner Pro workflow and rejects OEM VIOSO calibration results.
